_doc: Merge into the project's .claude/settings.json. The three hooks that wire Claude to the shared engine: every guarded tool call, every prompt, and every session start is piped to claude/shim.mjs, which self-locates deny-rules.json and prints the verdict JSON (SessionStart is a pure inject — the crash-resume FIRST-action reminder, no engine evaluation). Path assumes the adapter ships at .ai-dev/tooling/src/adapter/ — rewrite it if vendored elsewhere. See INSTALL.md.
